notes: Opening-day player and goalie models use supervised season-to-season transition learning because no 2026-27 regular-season game history exists yet.
Current NHL lineup/goalie context and NHL season projections are used as bounded context features/blends; FanDuel price is excluded from probability estimation.
Game moneyline/spread/total probabilities are v0.1 team-goal hybrid probabilities. They will transition toward trained rolling game-level models as 2026-27 observations accumulate.
A pre-lock full-team-name/abbreviation mapping bug was detected and corrected. The discarded run was never official.
